Two independently constructed full-state algorithms classify exactly all 43,046,721 states for each graph and agree on all 40 first-entry/primitive-period cells. All 104 primitive four-cycles are separately enumerated, and full automorphism groups are verified by construction and sharp vertex-stabilizer bounds. A further independent graph-invariant program checks the exact strongly regular matrix identity and all four-cycle firing profile populations.
